title: S07T03 - Expose import, export, search, spec, agent, and dashboard adapter points
description: Define bounded interfaces for external data adapters and views while preserving project boundaries, stable output contracts, and untrusted-data handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapters receive capability-scoped inputs and return schema-validated results without direct unrestricted access to Boreal storage.
A failing extension cannot corrupt canonical state, pollute JSON stdout, or cross project/memory boundaries.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
